purpose: First bounded memory-only continual-harness pilot on the qualified Sol High six-tool MedRAX base, measuring acquisition and retention from a common pre-B state.
author_base: Same six native tools, prompts, two-turn scoring and isolated subscription transport as v4. No tool/backbone/prompt tuning or forced tool calls.

selection.A: One image and metadata categories contains diagnosis
selection.B: Two to four images and metadata categories contains comparison
selection.case_assignment: B-eligible case groups assigned to B first; A sampled from remaining cases. One seeded metadata-selected question per case.
selection.exclusions: All prior 60 development cases and known shared canonical image paths/source URLs; case groups and shared source identities disjoint across roles.
selection.labels: Freeze member list using metadata only before associating labels. Only training labels reach memory proposal generation. Selection/anchor labels are numeric evaluator-only. Report labels read after all candidate states and all report predictions are fixed.
selection.interpretation: Observed task-format composition, not inferred disease comorbidity, chronological drift or patient-independent clinical evaluation. At most four images bounds input cost.

method.core: Reuse repository ExperienceMemory raw/abstract construction and vqa_local_v2.local_bank; memory-only restriction, not the full six-component HCL optimizer.
method.training: One batch of eight per stage; predictions use fixed incoming state. Record all eight feedback interactions, then one model abstraction proposal; no report or anchor examples become memory.
method.update: One raw+abstract local candidate per stage, at most two new raw records by frozen training order; capacity10, no task-conditioned retrieval. Stage A updates main_policy, stage B failure_avoidance; other slots unchanged. No candidate search or repair by selection answers.
method.retrieval: Frozen lexical Jaccard top2 over official de-labelled raw and abstract views; same selector for all learned states. Empty baseline receives no added context.
method.A_gate: Commit iff selection correct count increases by at least one and all eight candidate finals are valid/completed.
method.B_common_state: All B train interactions and its single proposal originate from the same accepted H_A; no branch-specific retraining.
method.B_local_infinite: Commit same candidate iff B selection correct increases by at least one and all eight candidate finals valid/completed.
method.B_local_zero: Same B criterion plus zero correct-to-wrong losses on the eight frozen A anchors relative to H_A. Gains never offset losses. Any incomplete anchor evaluation fails closed.
method.state_reuse: Exactly identical states share report predictions; no resampling to manufacture branch differences. H_A common state and identical B predictions reused for both gates.

report.full_denominators: All48 report cases for every named state, with failed/not-run counted wrong; planned maximum256 case episodes plus two abstraction calls, deduplication reported.
outcomes: B immediate gain H_AB minus H_A
memory actual occupancy and changed/retained entries
report.joint_development_signal: A report net gain>=1, B report net gain>=1, G_A nonempty with zero losses and zero A base-correct losses under Local-zero, final total gain>=2 over H0. All requirements and independent report completeness required; single seed/order and n24/task only development evidence.
report.gate_contribution: Only identified in this pilot if Local-infinite commits, Local-zero rejects specifically due to old-anchor loss, and the rejected state causes observed A report losses. Identical states do not establish gate benefit.
report.statistics: Report exact paired four-cell counts and two-sided exact McNemar descriptively; no multiplicity-adjusted or clinical efficacy claim. No report-driven retuning in this run.

stop_rules: No expansion of candidates, labels, seeds or budgets after partial results. Runtime failures and budget stops preserve states and full denominators. New hypotheses require a distinct protocol after complete analysis.
